class.name: CrimsonWeaponAnimationTracks
class.brief_description: Editable marker, notify and curve data owned by an Animation.
class.description: Tracks preserve the existing weapon Tweaker metadata format. Use [method from_animation] to inspect or edit a detached draft and [method write_to] to validate and store it.

method.name: from_animation
method.description: Read a detached draft from the clip. An animation without metadata starts with empty tracks. An invalid clip or invalid metadata returns null.

method.name: write_to
method.description: Save a detached track copy on the animation. Validating against the animation's duration is part of writing. Invalid data returns false and leaves the animation unchanged. Empty tracks remove the metadata.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Check that the metadata version, records, and timeline bounds are valid for the given positive duration in seconds.

members.member: Serialization schema version. Readers reject rows from unrecognized versions.
Ordered marker rows with a unique nonempty name, time in seconds and optional color.

Ordered named notify lanes. Each lane contains [code]notifies[/code] rows with a name, start [code]time[/code], optional [code]kind[/code] and [code]color[/code], and [code]end_time[/code]. Use -1 as the end time for an instantaneous notify.

Ordered uniquely named curve lanes. Each contains [code]curve[/code] keys with normalized phases, interpolation modes, and incoming and outgoing tangent data. Native [Curve] resources with a domain from zero to one are also accepted.
